id.description: snake_case unique identifier. Matches lore graph place ID where applicable.

biome.description: Biome this location spawns in. References biome_profiles.json.

description.description: Short in-game description shown when the player discovers or examines the location.

faction_presence.description: Faction IDs with a presence here. Affects NPC spawns and structure selection.

services.description: What the player can do at this location.

npcs.description: Named NPC IDs that spawn here. Overrides biome spawn tables.

lore_graph_id.description: Optional. Maps to the chronicle graph place ID for the export pipeline.
